ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.
   C. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.
   C. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.
   C. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam .

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.
   B. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat and Zakatul Fitr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Saum , and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dimensions of Morality in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
